entries.081fac27f05c3e54: This is a category of businesses that are not included in reportable segments. It runs the Funeral Consulting Business, which handles planning and consulting for weddings and funerals, a continuous employment support business, agriculture, a restaurant business, and the manufacture and sale of fertilizer. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥452 million.
entries.152c603c50e8c93d: This is a business that procures fresh flowers from producers, wholesale markets and wholesalers in Japan and overseas, and sells them to fresh flower retailers and funeral-related companies; it also handles the procurement of fresh flowers used in the Fresh Flower Altar Business. It has bidding-right contracts with wholesale markets across the country, and at overseas production areas its employees provide production guidance and quality control, and it also imports directly. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥2,516 million, and this is handled by consolidated subsidiary My Sakusesu Co., Ltd.
entries.18cce0cba6a6ee48: Headquartered in Minami Ward, Kumamoto City, Kumamoto Prefecture, the company and nine consolidated subsidiaries form the group. It runs the Fresh Flower Altar Business, the Fresh Flower Wholesale Business and the Bridal Flower Arrangement Business, and the number of employees for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was 248. It is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.205a414f3495f106: Wedding venues (hotels, specialized wedding halls, guest houses, restaurants)
entries.6edb39d63d998366: A holding company headquartered in Kumamoto, whose main business is fresh-flower altars for funerals, and which also handles wholesale of fresh flowers and floral decoration for weddings.
entries.c78bf18f69f1f9ce: This is a business that produces fresh flowers used in funerals, such as fresh flower altars and kuge, for funeral-related companies, and sells them including their installation. Its strengths lie in design that responds to the requests of the bereaved family, such as proposals for original altars reflecting the tastes and personality of the deceased and standardized low-priced fresh flower altars. It has bases across the country, and revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥4,015 million.
entries.dc58359b7c7a3695: This is a business that produces bridal flower products, such as takasago-bana, table flowers and bouquets, for wedding venues such as hotels, specialized wedding halls, guest houses and restaurants, and sells them including their installation. It is fully reservation-based, and a distinctive feature is that staff meet directly with the bride and groom to decide the content. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥317 million.
